content.scenarioBrief: During a daily stand-up, the learner clarifies what updating the dashboard means before committing to the task.

turns.text: Quick stand-up. You are up. What are you picking up today?
I can take the dashboard task, but I want to make sure I understand the scope. Does updating the dashboard mean the layout or the underlying data?
Good question. The data source changed, so the charts need to show the new fields.
Understood. So it is the data mapping, not a redesign. I will start with the field list and confirm it with you before I change anything.
Perfect. Send me the field list by lunch and we are aligned.
